author: Codex root

findings.assessment: The wrapper requires the exact Q worktree and cwd, caller-pinned own source and input, fixed accepted commit/probe hashes, and the actual exclusive token hash before consuming its attempt. The fixed source files are checked again through the protected pin map before the probe is imported.
Only the fresh wrapper-local attempt directory and exclusive start/receipt files are written. A consumed attempt is rejected. This source does not call the commit runner or transaction helper.

The candidate expected-input map and explicit evidence/source/review/receipt/supplement/finalized descriptors form the protected pin map. Each initial cached read verifies its hash; every returned Buffer is copied. The probe receives only read, exists and list adapter methods and its own negative mutations remain in memory.

Successful probe status and every case are required. Main failure is caught with partial probe cases/observations; both success and failure continue into own-source, protected-file and observed-existence rechecks against real disk. Any main or postcheck error yields ok false and process exit 1. A successful receipt therefore requires all enumerated postchecks to complete.

limitations: This acceptance applies only to the frozen wrapper source. The actual complete commit input, candidate evidence, finalized metadata and exact contract still require independent review before dispatch.
The wrapper is intentionally executable at top level. This reviewer has only read raw source and hashes; root must pin it in the actual command before invocation and never import it for inspection.

The supplied adapter is a read-only raw filesystem adapter, not the commit realAdapter. This wrapper acceptance depends on the exact root-owned reviewed input and exclusive writer window; it does not test Windows symlink/junction confinement or filesystem transaction behavior.
If a postcheck discovers drift, its loop stops on that first assertion and the receipt is failed. Such a receipt is not a complete unchanged-input witness and must not authorize commit.
Errors before the main try block or failure to write the receipt remain process/attempt evidence for the outer root dispatcher. A failed or incomplete attempt must not be replayed.
Production mutations, project/native/browser execution, actual guard outcomes, commit and persisted validation are not established by source inspection.
